reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited Section 9.8/9.9 text supports it: frequency cap ('shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year'), advance written notice, independent auditor of international prominence reasonably acceptable to the audited Party, auditor confidentiality agreement (9.9(d)), report limited to non-compliance and discrepancy amount (9.9(b)), and auditing Party bearing cost unless underpayment exceeds a stated percentage (9.9(c)).
No walk-away trigger is present: there is no unannounced or unlimited audit right and no direct or remote access to Customer systems — only books and records held by the audited Party.
The clause is fully reciprocal (each Party may audit the other), so it does not operate solely against us and should not be redlined.
Consistent with the compliant classification, no redline was rendered and no counterparty comment was proposed — the correct treatment for internal evaluation evidence.

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is explained by redaction: the numeral is present as '[***] in a given Calendar Year', a phrasing/redaction variant rather than an absent cap. The rationale appropriately flags that the redacted notice period and underpayment percentage should be confirmed against the unredacted execution copy, and treats the 'unless for cause' carve-out as a minor sub-element noted rather than flagged.
